questions.prompt: You see `-> Result<Config, ConfigError>` vs `-> anyhow::Result<Config>` — what do they tell you?

options.b: The first is library-style (callers match variants); the second is app-style (callers report)

questions.prompt: What is LOST when an error is converted into `anyhow::Result`?

options.b: Callers can no longer pattern match on specific error variants — fine for apps, wrong for libraries
